title: StudySession
description: YAML front matter of course/units/NN-slug/sessions/NN.md. The at-home study session (D-012). THIS IS THE METHODOLOGY CONTRACT (D-011) — downstream agents consume `goals`, never the methodology that produced them.

accepted.description: The teacher's deliberate exceptions for THIS file (D-037). Each entry suppresses one validation rule's findings for this file; `classkit validate` still counts them, so they are never invisible. Only the teacher adds these — an agent never does so on its own.

rule.description: The rule code, as `classkit validate` prints it in brackets, e.g. 'in_class_missing'. Not pattern-checked on purpose: a mistyped code is reported by the advisory rule `unknown_rule`, never as a schema error (D-038).

id.description: Optional (D-048): the one item this exception covers — an objective (U01-O3), a guiding question (U01-S02-G1), an activity (U01-A1), an assessment item (U01-I01), a unit (U03) or a material locator (M0007#slide-3). Without it, the exception covers the rule's findings for the whole file. An id that matches nothing is counted with the stale entries.

reason.description: Why the departure is deliberate, e.g. 'holiday week — no class meeting'. Optional: a missing reason is reported by the advisory rule `accepted_without_reason`, never as a schema error (D-038).

goals.description: Session goals. Under question-driven-25 these are 3-5 Guiding Questions. Other methodologies emit other item types — hence `type`.

id.description: e.g. 'U01-S02-G1'. THE atomic addressable unit — referenced by activities, assessment items and the Gem.

type.description: question-driven-25 emits only 'question'. Other methodologies may emit the rest.

prompt.description: The guiding question, phrased as a question the student should be able to answer. For non-question types, the task statement.

objectives.description: Unit Objectives this goal rolls up to.

est_minutes.description: The teacher-approved time to study this question (D-020). The session's budget is the sum of these plus the overhead (`session_budget_feasibility`). Not required by the schema: a missing estimate makes that rule report the session as unverifiable (D-038).

answer.description: Where the correct answer is found — precise locators, never the answer in prose (D-019). Expected unless `defer_to_class` is true; its absence is advice (`answer_reference_present`), not a schema error (D-037).

defer_to_class.description: A pre-class thinking prompt whose answer is deferred to the class meeting (D-023): it carries no `answer`, and ≥1 activity of the unit's class hour must pick it up (`deferred_question_resolved_in_class`). Its `est_minutes` is thinking time and still counts.

paths.description: DEPRECATED (D-020): study paths are one pool per session — the session's `paths`. Still read, so an older session stays valid; `goal_paths_moved` asks to move them. Never summed.

kind.description: slides and notes added by D-040 (a teacher's own deck is the material most likely to be cited); the full resource-kind vocabulary lands in step 4.

ref.description: Prefer a material locator, written in full ('M0007#slide-18'), which the validator checks; else a URL, or a textbook key with locator, e.g. 'CLRS ch.3 pp.45-52'.

est_minutes.description: Estimated time. If omitted, derived from defaults/time-constants.yaml.

paths.description: The session's study paths (D-020): an open, optional pool of alternative resources — a chapter, a video, the class Gem. None is mandatory and the list is not exhaustive; a student may use their own. Not tagged to questions, not time-summed.

kind.description: The resource-kind vocabulary (D-040): a material's kinds, plus `gem` and `web`. Optional when `ref` is a material locator — the manifest records its kind; required otherwise.

ref.description: Where: prefer a material locator written in full ('M0007#slide-18'), which the validator checks (D-035); else a URL, or a textbook key with its locator ('CLRS §2.3.1'). Never the answer in prose, never invented (invariant 7).

note.description: For a book, its own coordinates — section, exercise, printed page — since `page-N` is the PDF's page (D-039); for a video, the timestamp.

kind.description: The resource-kind vocabulary (D-040): a material's kinds, plus `gem` and `web`. Optional when `ref` is a material locator — the manifest records its kind; required otherwise.

ref.description: Where: prefer a material locator written in full ('M0007#slide-18'), which the validator checks (D-035); else a URL, or a textbook key with its locator ('CLRS §2.3.1'). Never the answer in prose, never invented (invariant 7).

note.description: For a book, its own coordinates — section, exercise, printed page — since `page-N` is the PDF's page (D-039); for a video, the timestamp.

est_minutes.description: Optional: a rough time, to help a student choose. Never summed (D-020).
